extras: This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: It is the successor to File Color, which has not been updated in almost three years.
motivation: To provide a maintained and updated successor to the unmaintained File Color plugin.
problem: Users lack a simple way to visually distinguish specific files or folders within the Obsidian file explorer.

relations.evidence: It is the successor to File Color, which has not been updated in almost three years.

summary: A tool that allows users to color files and folders directly within the Obsidian file explorer using a custom palette.
